reviews.comment:
Took Prof Matusevich for MATH 300 (Foundations)
She is very caring and wants students to succeed in her course, but she is very slow at grading both tests and homework. Did not give us back our final project drafts from weeks ago until two days before grades were due.

Everything you need to know is in the book, and you can bring the book to exams. Homework was hard, but exams weren't so bad and were curved. Lecture was not necessary or useful for completing hw or exams. Takes an eternity to grade exams. Friendly.
She is sometimes hard to understand and has a little bit of an accent. But she is super nice with you and will work with you to understand the concepts.

Lectures feel slow. She writes the lecture notes by hand during the class. Although this is great during lectures, it makes it difficult to do the homework as you usually don't have access to her notes until the day the homework is due.

She seems sweet but she tends to overcomplicate subjects that are not inherently difficult. The course is heavily disorganized and everything she posts is crammed into the announcement page on canvas (she doesn't have any other pages).

One of the only math profs I've learned from at tamu. Plenty of in class examples. Occasionally her arithmetic or algebra is wrong, but she will usually notice and correct. Exams are not overly difficult, and she curves exams when necessary.

Although she is a nice person, Matusevich is definitely the worst math teacher I have had at A&M. Class is 80% test based, her lectures are rushed, she provides little to no resources outside of class and she is a highly unorganized teacher. Tests are 5 questions and she takes forever to give back grades.

She goes through the unit fairly fast with limited time for examples/practice problems, so lectures aren't amazing. However, she does care for her students and is one of the sweetest professors I've had this semester. I'm rating a 4 bc I think she deserves a 3.5 rating. P.S: the class gets a lot harder after the first test.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She's a nice person but I could not learn from her teaching style. Class seemed rushed and like no one in the class knows what is happening.

I was worried when my professor changed at the last minute to Laura because of her awful reviews on here, but she turned out to be a super kind and helpful professor. She could be kind of hard to understand at times, but she was good at explaining concepts when asked. The biggest thing I can say is that things get a lot harder after the first test.

Dr. Matusevich was such a sweet lady. Her lectures are kinda boring, but she explains the concepts thoroughly and is available outside of class. Her tests were very much like the homework and her grading scale is the most realistic ever, drops the lowest quiz grade, HW grade and one problem that you did the worst on on each exam. Would recommend!
Her exams can be pretty difficult but she's willing to help you if you put in effort. Not my favorite prof, but not my least favorite either. Sweet lady.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Honestly the worst math class I have ever taken. Accent takes a while to get used to and then there's a bit of a language barrier that makes a tough class that much harder. Never seems able to answer any question directly. She's a difficult grader and tests are hard and open ended. She also doesn't post grades online so you don't know your average.

She is really nice and makes sure you understand the concepts being taught. Her accent and handwriting takes time to get used to. There is homework every week and a quiz every Wednesday, length of 10 mins. The exams and quiz are easy, she makes sure that review takes place before exam day and sends out a practice exam as well.
Lectures are unclear often. Exams are difficult, with short time for completion. To succeed, rely on textbook and practice problems much more.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS
